applies_to.reference_rule: The CPU reference must use the same algorithm, equations, operation ordering, substep boundaries, solver iteration ordering, and input snapshots as the GPU path. Different algorithms are compared using analytic fixtures and physical invariants, not frame-by-frame trajectory equality.

runtime_hard_limits.scope: Runtime-wide Host-configured admission guards applied to every World Admission Limit
runtime_hard_limits.calibration: These values are immutable Host policy guards, not Runtime-certified GPU-safe maxima. Gate R6 measurements record the adapter, driver, Windows build, Runtime build, shader package and workload envelope used by the Host to choose the values. The Runtime validates only non-zero uint32 values and World Admission Limits <= these values. It does not authenticate a profile, verify a signature, or claim that these two counts bound total GPU work or prevent TDR.
runtime_hard_limits.host_responsibility: Before initialize, the Host selects the deployment capability profile, verifies that its adapter LUID / vendor and device IDs / driver version / Windows build / Runtime build / shader package identity match the active environment, and applies its own deployment policy. The Runtime receives the selected numeric limits and freezes them for its lifetime.
not_bounded_by_these_two_limits: total GPU execution time or Windows TDR deadline
runtime_hard_limits.acceptance: initialize rejects zero Hard Limits. create_world and set_world_execution_budget reject zero or over-Hard-Limit World Admission Limits without mutating Budget, Revision, Reservation or Timeline. Values above Hard Limits are invalid_argument. These checks do not imply that a within-limit Workload is TDR-safe.

deployment_profile_qualification_policy.qualification: A selected calibration trial must satisfy every declared frame-time, GPU-tick, CPU-submission and local-memory budget after the declared headroom is applied. Its measured workload and selected Runtime Hard Limits must come from that same trial. Never combine per-dimension maxima from different trials.
deployment_profile_qualification_policy.hard_limit_rule: selected maximum_world_substeps_hard_limit and maximum_integration_segments_per_tick_hard_limit must be <= the corresponding values tested in the selected passing trial. Selected geometry / constraint / candidate / contact / iteration / memory limits must also be <= the corresponding tested dimensions.
deployment_profile_qualification_policy.failure_rule: Missing policy inputs, identity mismatch, insufficient repetitions, exceeded timing or memory budget, nonzero quality reduction, dropped work, or missing raw measurement evidence makes the profile not_qualified. Host must not use its numeric caps.

hard_limit_selection_modes.measured_maximum: selected Runtime Hard Limits equal the same qualified Trial's tested Substep and Integration Segment maxima
hard_limit_selection_modes.host_conservative_override: selected Runtime Hard Limits may be lower than the same qualified Trial's tested maxima only when a non-empty Host rationale is recorded before deployment
hard_limit_selection_modes.prohibition: No selected limit may exceed the matching tested value; do not combine dimensions from separate calibration trials.

deployment_profile_qualification_policy.test_scene_policy: The selected calibration trial must include every unique required_test_scene_ids entry from the target_workload_envelope; the exact executed scene IDs are retained in each trial row and raw evidence bundle.

normalization.length_reference: median positive rest-edge length in the Physics Mesh
normalization.mass_reference: median positive dynamic Physics Vertex mass
normalization.time_reference: actual Integration Segment duration used by the compared update
normalization.contact_mass_reference: median positive dynamic Physics Vertex mass pooled across every Mesh participating in the World Contact Solver; if no positive dynamic mass exists, all Contacts are NON_RESPONSIVE_CONTACT and no impulse reference is evaluated
normalization.contact_length_reference: median positive rest-edge length pooled across every Mesh participating in the World Contact Solver
normalization.contact_impulse_reference: contact_mass_reference * contact_length_reference / actual dt_contact (dt_segment for Discrete Contact; tau for TOI prefix)

animation_trajectory_position.reference: independent CPU-double evaluation of the same Span Packet at identical normalized tau

animation_trajectory_velocity.reference: analytical derivative of the final blended, hierarchical, skinned trajectory

cloth_bend_analytic_gradient_vs_central_.step_size_policy: scale perturbation from per-mesh length_reference and avoid degenerate hinge configurations

xpbd_projected_lambda_delta_consistency.identity: lambda_next - lambda_old equals applied_delta_lambda; position correction uses that same applied delta

animation_packet_derivative.reference: central difference of independent CPU-double trajectory at interior tau; do not sample across STEP / Span discontinuities

contact_penetration_after_solve.applies_to: fixtures whose configured solver iteration and substep budget is expected to converge

candidate_completeness.small_scene_reference: broadphase candidates must contain every VT / EE pair found by exhaustive CPU reference

ccd.unresolved_candidate_policy: reject logical step; never reinterpret unresolved as no-hit

contact_projection_velocity_leakage.rule: v_pre_contact is captured after non-contact constraints and before Contact Position XPBD; Contact positional correction must not change the saved velocity used by Friction / Restitution.

contact_restitution_energy_source.policy: restitution uses relative velocity sampled before Contact Position correction
contact_restitution_energy_source.applies_to: fixtures with no external force / no incoming normal kinetic energy and restitution=0

animation_trajectory_bounds.reference: independent CPU-double interval bounds plus adversarial dense samples inside every Animation Span
animation_trajectory_bounds.unbounded_span_policy: split deterministically up to depth 8; then BLOCKED_BY_INPUT / CCDUnresolved and no commit

non_responsive_contact.diagnostic: NON_RESPONSIVE_CONTACT exactly once per canonical contact event
non_responsive_contact.threshold: epsilon_inverse_mass = 1e-12 / mass_reference_world [1/kg]; mass_reference_world is the median positive dynamic Vertex mass [kg] across participating World meshes. No positive dynamic mass means all contacts are non-responsive.

residual_definition.tangent: length(j_t - project_to_disk(j_t - v_t / W_ii, friction * (j_support + j_n)))

coupled_contact_impulse.unresolved_policy: CONTACT_IMPULSE_UNRESOLVED rejects the entire Logical Tick; never commit a non-converged impact

contact_impulse_energy.applies_to: isolated contact fixtures without external work; measure post-Impulse velocity after removing positional projection work

integration_segment_budget.overflow_policy: WORK_BUDGET_EXCEEDED preserves the Tick Reservation; never merge distinct Animation / Force / Impulse / TOI boundaries

animation_gpu_packet_time.reference: CPU-double absolute timeline mapped to Span-local normalized u and Segment-relative tau; compare GPU u_tau against an independent CPU-double evaluator at both early and large absolute World Times
animation_gpu_packet_time.residual_segment_rule: u_segment_start advances after every positive-duration Segment by dt_segment / span_duration; TOI uses tau / span_duration; at the next Animation Span boundary switch Record and initialize u_segment_start=0
animation_gpu_packet_time.precision_failure_policy: split deterministically up to depth 8; then ANIMATION_TIME_PRECISION_UNRESOLVED and no Commit
animation_gpu_packet_time.cursor_buffer_role: Mutable per-World UAV / Working State; not part of the immutable trajectory Packet
animation_gpu_packet_time.cursor_update_policy: GPU advances Cursor after each Segment; TOI retime / Retry restore Cursor from Segment Snapshot; Tick Reject discards Working Cursor without mutating committed Packet / Cursor state

toi_snap_error_budget.distance_tolerance: Required per CCD fixture / workload [m]; no default is implied.
toi_snap_error_budget.relative_velocity_tolerance: Required per CCD fixture / workload [m/s]; no default is implied.
toi_snap_error_budget.impulse_tolerance: Required per CCD fixture / workload [N*s]; no default is implied.
toi_snap_error_budget.snap_allowed_only_when: time delta <= tau_snap_tolerance AND conservative total post-XPBD position error <= distance_tolerance AND conservative Contact-relative Velocity error <= relative_velocity_tolerance AND conservative post-Restitution/Friction Impulse error <= impulse_tolerance. XPBD position / velocity error must be evaluated from complete finite-iteration G_p / G_v maps over an uncertainty set enclosing Candidate and Boundary inputs; all reachable active-set / projection branches and both solver residuals must be enclosed.
toi_snap_error_budget.xpbd_solver_map_definition: G_p(z,dt) is the exact finite-iteration XPBD position solver map and G_v(z,dt) is the exact production velocity-response map derived from G_p and the production velocity reconstruction rule; for Dynamic Vertex it includes (G_p(z,dt)-x_segment_start)/dt and any subsequent deterministic velocity update, while Fixed / Kinematic Vertex uses the analytic trajectory derivative at the same time. It includes production constraint order, iteration count, relaxation, projection, clamp and lambda update rules. z includes segment-start position / velocity, trajectory inputs, constraint gradients, effective inverse masses, compliance, rest data, active set and projection branch. U encloses Candidate and Boundary inputs; E_Gp = sup_{z in U} ||G_p(z,dt)-G_p(z_boundary,dt_boundary)||_2 and E_Gv is defined analogously. Add candidate and boundary residual / numerical evaluation bounds in position / velocity units unless already enclosed by interval output. Use outward-rounded interval / affine arithmetic or a proven global Jacobian/operator norm propagated over every iteration. Enumerate every reachable active-set / unilateral constraint / clamp / projection branch. If any branch, input interval, finite upper bound or residual conversion cannot be certified, the XPBD bound is unknown and Snap is forbidden. Sample maxima and finite differences are not conservative bounds.
toi_snap_error_budget.unknown_or_non_finite_bound_policy: Snap forbidden; retain exact tau and create an independent interior Boundary. If exact-tau CCD cannot be evaluated safely, reject the Logical Tick as CCDUnresolved.
toi_snap_error_budget.impulse_bound_definition: For the complete deterministic finite-iteration coupled contact solve F, construct a validated input uncertainty set U enclosing both candidate-time and snap-boundary states. E_impulse = sup over z in U of ||F(z)-F(z_boundary)||_2, with the interval enclosure including normal and tangential impulse components, Delassus/effective-mass matrix, normal basis, relative velocity, restitution, friction, XPBD support impulse, compliance/dt inputs and both solver residuals. A certified decomposition may use E_impulse <= E_normal_scalar + 2*J_normal_max*sin(theta_normal_max/2) + E_friction_vector + E_solver_residual. E_normal_scalar and E_friction_vector must be validated upper bounds over U, not sampled estimates. The solver must prove finite positive lower bounds for the responsive Delassus eigenvalues and enclose every iteration. If the contact active set / projection branch cannot be enclosed, a coupled solve is unbounded, or any interval is missing, Snap is forbidden. For an uncoupled scalar / diagonal Effective-Mass special case only, j_n=max(0,-(1+e)*v_n/K_n) admits E_normal_scalar <= ((1+e_max)*Delta_v_n+v_n_max*Delta_e)/K_n_min + (1+e_max)*v_n_max*Delta_K_n/(K_n_min^2), where K_n_min>0 and all deltas / maxima enclose Candidate and Boundary inputs. For isotropic scalar tangential mass, j_t=ProjectDisk(-v_t/K_t, radius=mu*(j_n+lambda_n/dt_contact)) admits E_friction_vector <= Delta_v_t/K_t_min + v_t_max*Delta_K_t/(K_t_min^2) + s_max*Delta_mu + mu_max*(E_normal_scalar+Delta_lambda_n/dt_min+lambda_n_max*Delta_inverse_dt), with K_t_min>0, dt_min>0, s_max=j_n_max+lambda_n_max/dt_min. Delta_v_t includes tangent-basis rotation. These scalar formulas are prohibited for coupled / non-diagonal Contact Islands; use the complete F interval bound instead. E_solver_residual is added separately and includes Normal and Tangential residuals in impulse units.
impulse_error_components: normal effective-mass / Delassus operator interval variation, including a strictly positive lower eigenvalue bound
contact normal angular/directional variation and the induced normal-vector impulse rotation error
relative normal / tangential velocity interval variation
restitution coefficient interval variation and its effect on the normal impulse
friction coefficient and Coulomb-disk / stick-slip projection variation, including XPBD support impulse lambda_n / dt_contact
finite-iteration coupled solver response and certified solver-residual interval for the complete contact island
restitution and friction response to relative velocity error
toi_snap_error_budget.note: Tolerance values must be supplied by the reviewed fixture / workload profile. Missing values never authorize Snap.

benchmark_policy.percentile_definition: Sort pooled raw samples ascending and select the 1-based observation at rank ceil(0.95 * N); do not interpolate.

profiles.mixed_mesh_pairs: include Soft Body / Soft Body, Cloth / Cloth, Soft Body / Cloth and self-collision cases

benchmark_policy.fps_acceptance: The requirement's 3-40 FPS range is an evaluation target, not a fixed guarantee for every asset profile. Report measured FPS with all quality gates and workload metadata.
benchmark_policy.gpu_timing: Use asynchronous D3D11 timestamp/disjoint queries. Separate CPU submission, GPU pass time, total physics time, Render Feedback time and frame time.
benchmark_policy.memory: Record SkinPhysics-owned allocation bytes separately from DXGI local-memory CurrentUsage and Budget.
benchmark_policy.quality_policy: Do not reduce solver quality, collision scope, substeps or iteration count silently to improve a performance result. Cloth Temporal Quality Limit is a constraint-frequency quality heuristic, not a proof of XPBD stability; its factor is recorded and calibrated separately. Contact Temporal Quality Limit is an explicit timestep cap, default 1/120 s; it is not a stiffness-derived stability proof. GPU Animation Trajectory Packet evaluation must be profiled separately from CPU Packet preparation time. maximum_integration_segments_per_tick counts World Substep, Animation Span, Force / Impulse and dynamically added TOI segments. Exceeding the cap preserves the same Tick Reservation without coalescing boundaries. D3D11 SM5 Animation Packet uses float / uint32 only. Absolute World Time stays CPU double; GPU uses Span-local normalized u and Segment-relative tau. Verify every GPU Record stride against animation_gpu_packet_time.expected_record_bytes; this object is the sole byte-size source. The five immutable Packet Records and the separate mutable 16-byte World Cursor are classified by animation_gpu_packet_time.record_roles. Every Animation Span Record owns explicit Track / Channel / Blend / Collider Buffer Ranges; Blend Source / Target Track indices are Span-relative and range-checked. Each Channel Record carries Node Role and Inverse Bind Static Record Index; invalid references, omitted Mesh Node or omitted Joint Ancestor records fail the animation packet ABI gate. Immutable Packet mutation count, Cursor Snapshot Restore mismatch and rejected-Tick Cursor leak must all remain zero.

threshold_changes_require: rerun of all analytical, numerical, physical and integration tests

version_history.changes: Defined complete finite-iteration XPBD position / velocity maps G_p and G_v over Candidate / Boundary uncertainty sets, including active-set and projection branch enclosure. Standardized pooled raw-sample p95 to nearest_rank. Deployment Profile Template v1.4 records the percentile method.

Defined a validated full Contact-Island impulse uncertainty-set bound, added computable scalar Effective-Mass / restitution / friction special-case bounds, and prohibited scalar shortcuts for coupled contact islands. Deployment Profile v1.3 stores independent Run records as an array and computes p95 from pooled raw samples.

Added mandatory TOI Snap error budgets for post-XPBD position, contact-relative velocity and impact impulse; Snap falls back to exact tau whenever any conservative bound or fixture tolerance is unavailable. Deployment qualification requires at least five independent runs with >=1000 raw samples per measured series and target Substep / Segment dimensions within selected Hard Limits.

Clarified measured_maximum as the default Hard Limit selection policy; lower caps require a documented Host conservative override from the same qualified Trial. Template v1.1 defines complete trial schema and target workload mapping. The selected trial must cover every required test scene ID.

Clarified Runtime Hard Limits as Host-configured admission guards, added deployment capability profile provenance requirements, removed Runtime-certified/TDR-safe claims, and documented dimensions not bounded by Substep/Segment limits.
Added the execution-budget defaults and mandatory immutable Runtime Hard Limit contract with per-deployment GPU/driver calibration requirements.
Removed the stale 64 / 208 / 48 / 128 byte stride list. expected_record_bytes is the single ABI byte-size source; immutable Packet records and the mutable World Cursor are explicitly separated.
Initial Animation Packet ABI sizes, normalized Span time, Cursor rollback, and non-responsive / coupled contact acceptance thresholds.
